name: trade-server-mcp
description: Trade on a YourBourse Trade Server from Claude — trader or manager, detected automatically when you sign in.

yb_base_url.title: Server address
yb_base_url.description: https://your-server.example.com — your Trade Server's web address, from your broker (include https://, no trailing slash; sometimes it has a port). Managers: use your admin API address.

yb_login.title: Account login
yb_login.description: Your account number, digits only. Works for traders and managers — your role is detected automatically when the extension signs in.

yb_password.title: Password
yb_password.description: Stored securely in your operating system's keychain.

yb_broker.title: Broker name (optional)
yb_broker.description: Leave blank unless your broker told you to set it.
